_why: Publishing is not allowed unless these checks on the tagged commit are green. The names come from .github/workflows/ci.yml; adding or renaming a job means editing both files in the same PR.
required: the tool on a real plugin
_optional: node 22 on macos-latest (arm64) is not required: GitHub frequently has no arm64 runner for it. The arm64 job listens to it directly and 'arm64 job did not hide a test failure' is required instead.
required_alternatives: arm64 job did not hide a test failure
capacity_policy: A check that was CANCELLED without ever acquiring a runner is a capacity problem, not a test failure: it is reported and skipped. A cancelled check whose job really started, or one whose job state cannot be read, is a failure.
